quests.title: Paint one stripe
quests.ask: Write `fill_row()`: paint the top stripe, a gem on each of its cells, ending just past its east end, still facing east.
quests.nudge: Which two things happen on every cell? Those belong inside the loop.

quests.title: Over the gap to the next
quests.ask: Write `next_stripe()`: from just past the end of a stripe, get to the west end of the next stripe, facing east, leaving the row between empty.
quests.nudge: Where does `fill_row()` begin? That's exactly where `next_stripe()` has to leave the robot.

quests.title: All three stripes
quests.ask: Repeat the pair of calls to paint every stripe, with an empty row after each one.
quests.nudge: Look at the Goal view. How many times does the pair need to run?
